group:paper-gaokao-2022-zhejiang-jan:clo.overview: 七十四岁的 Burdeyney 女士饱受眼疾困扰，发现许多同病者默默忍受。得知以色列一项干细胞眼科研究后，她看到希望，与朋友一起为项目筹款，并呼吁人们正视问题、积极行动。
group:paper-gaokao-2022-zhejiang-jan:clo.fullTranslationZh:
去年，Beverley Burdeyney 满七十四岁时，眼睛开始出问题，尤其是干涩和不适。

“我当时简直是在经历一段可怕的日子，”Burdeyney 女士在多伦多的家中说，“我感到那么无助、那么不安，因为我的生活质量受到了影响。”

Burdeyney 女士和一些有类似问题的朋友聊过，发现她们大多在默默忍受。“没人愿意谈这件事，因为它看起来是那么微不足道，”她说，“可是受折磨的人越来越多，生活正在受到损害。”

后来，Burdeyney 女士得知以色列特拉维夫大学有一个眼科研究项目的计划。研究团队包括加拿大医生 Allan Slomovic，他在利用干细胞护理眼睛方面做出了开创性的工作。看到一线希望，Burdeyney 女士开始和朋友、多伦多商人 Meyer Zeifman 一起为这个项目筹款。到目前为止，她已经筹到 11 万美元，预计还会有 4 万美元到位。

“我在努力让越来越多的人明白，问题是有解决办法的，”Burdeyney 女士说。她受过护士培训，退休后仍在做私人健身教练。“我说，问题不在年老，只在忽视。不要停在原地不动，要为它做点什么。”

Burdeyney 女士还说，她希望为这个研究项目做更多事。“我只想把光明带进人们的眼睛，而这只是个开始。还有很长的路要走。”

theme.text: 眼睛出了问题不该归咎年老、默默忍受，而要正视并行动起来，即 do something about it。

paragraphs.text: 七十四岁的她开始出现眼睛干涩不适的毛病。
她说这段经历很糟，生活质量受影响，感到无助不安。
她发现同病的朋友都在默默忍受，生活受到损害。
她得知一项眼科研究，看到希望，和朋友为它筹款。
她想让人们明白问题有办法，呼吁别停步、要行动。
她还想为项目多出力，说这只是开始，路还很长。

mainLine.emotion: 无助不安→看到希望→积极行动→满怀期待

completedSourceTexts.text: When Beverley Burdeyney turned seventy four last year, she started having problems with her eyes, notably dryness and discomfort.
“I was simply going through a terrible experience,” Ms.Burdeyney said at her home in Toronto. “I felt so helpless and insecure because the quality of my life was affected.”

Ms. Burdeyney talked to some friends who had similar problems and discovered that they were largely suffering in silence. “Nobody chooses to talk about it because it seems so insignificant,” she said. “But more and more are suffering and lives are being compromised.”

Eventually, Ms. Burdeyney learned about plans for an eye research program at Tel Aviv University in Israel. The research team included Canadian doctor Allan Slomovic, who has done ground-breaking work on eye care using stem cells. Seeing a ray of hope, Ms. Burdeyney began raising money for the project with a friend, Toronto businessman Meyer Zeifman. So far she has raised $ 110,000 with another $40,000 expected.

“I’m trying to get more and more people to understand that there are solutions(解决办法),” said Ms. Burdeyney, a trained nurse who is still working as a personal trainer after retirement. “I say there is no old age, there’s only neglect（忽视）. Don’t stand still, do something about it.”
Ms. Burdeyney added that she is hoping to do more for the research project. “I just want to bring light into people’s eyes and this is just the beginning. There is still a long way to go”
